protected_12v_RC.topology: Lower D3 cathode -> +12V_LOGIC_RAW -> R12 -> +12V_LOGIC; C8/C2/C13 and all regulator inputs remain after R12
protected_12v_RC.manufacturer_full_power_condition: 300 mm2 total solder pad and trace area at 70 C; 2 W is not a demonstrated PCB assembly thermal rating
protected_12v_RC.upstream_voltage_scope: Engineering 12 V source minus assumed D1/D3 drops, not a guaranteed minimum for every PSU/diode/temperature
protected_12v_RC.formula: (I-Ipanel)*(11.2-I*R)=Pconverter; Ipanel=0.108A; choose the low-current stable operating root
protected_12v_RC.temperature_scope: Above corner is resistor initial tolerance at the assumed input/load. TCR, diode drop, supply tolerance and converter efficiency vary with temperature; actual enclosure validation required.
protected_12v_RC.filter_scope: First-order unloaded RC estimate only; actual ESR, wiring inductance, converter input impedance and local decoupling change the response. RC does not clamp sustained overvoltage or guarantee EMC/reset immunity.

startup_pulse.capacitance_scope: Engineering ceiling including tolerances and module input capacitance; listed external nominal capacitors sum284.3uF after adding C52/C53. Unknown module internal capacitance and actual PSU startup must be verified.
startup_pulse.manufacturer_curve_category: Nominal resistance >=1 ohm; CRM datasheet page3
startup_pulse.comparison: The first1ms instantaneous bound176W is below the approximate220W rectangular-pulse graph. This is an engineering comparison, not repetitive/hot-start/surge qualification.
startup_pulse.tail_scope: The pure-RC tail excludes running converter load. Actual startup and repeated restart waveform/temperature remain prototype checks; do not infer full-circuit tail power from the unloaded RC formula.

static_all_LOW.scope: TI static ICC excludes external pullups; LOW pullup current bounded conservatively with zero sink voltage.7.2mA is higher envelope of3.3/5V ICC1 tables. Additional allowance is engineering reserve, not guaranteed arbitrary-rate/cable-capacitance operating current.

TLP2363.engineering_input_envelope_scope: 12V +/-10% is an explicit design assumption; minimum IF must be verified with the chosen PSU, wiring, contact resistance and temperature.
TLP2363.VF2p0V_scope: Engineering allowance; the Toshiba1.65V VFmaximum is only specified at2.6mA25C and is not treated as a guaranteed all-temperature value.
TLP2363.lower3v3_envelope_scope: Engineering envelope:25C additive accuracy/line/load, stated temperature coefficient over65K,5mV bead DC drop at100mA, plus half the60mVp-p reference ripple in each direction. Coefficient/ripple are not guaranteed worst-case limits; trace drops, startup and transients remain unbounded by this estimate.

logic_margins_with_GPPU_disabled.scope: Reuses existing TLP/MCP published test-condition limits; calculated after new supply engineering envelope. Positive static margins do not guarantee startup, hot-plug, EFT or surge performance.

TLP2363.common_ground_scope: DI LED/cable return and detector logic both use GND. Optical transfer does not establish galvanic isolation of the complete external dry-contact domain; no port-to-port isolation or assembly voltage-withstand rating is claimed.
prototype_checks: Measure lowest3V3, LOW/HIGH margins, relay-switch transients and brownout/reset behavior with all16 inputs closed and all16 relay coils energized.
Verify IF>=5mA at minimum external supply, cold, maximum intended cable/contact resistance; verify input resistor temperature at maximum supply.
Verify total common5V load, lower LDO temperature and R12 temperature in the intended enclosure; regulator efficiency and component temperature are not inferred from package ratings.
Verify all16 input transitions and readback/recovery with MCP GPPU disabled; check intended debounce and cable pickup after routing.
TLP2363.field_prefilter_startup_scope: On power-up with an open contact, C charges throughLED/Rshunt and1.2k;220R is outside this open-contact charging branch. Raw activeLOW can occur. Rshunt provides defined charging after LED current becomes small. Simple initialLED bound11.11mA is below15mA derated absolute limit at105C. Button/action qualification remains required.
TLP2363.historical_budget_note: Original LDO/5V numbers are retained in historical_5v_LDO_budget and prior SHA-bound reports only.

rows.typical_scope: Toshiba table typicals are at VCC5V25C; not an exact3.3V rail prediction.
rows.datasheet_max_scope: ICCH with IF0 and ICCL with IF5mA over the listed supply/temperature conditions. Application LED current5.7..9.4mA is not a new independently guaranteed test condition.
D004 at SCL/SCK1MHz; GPIO sourced loads and external pull-ups accounted separately. GPPU=0. Standby1uA/device is not used for active load budgeting.

rows.calculation: 16*3.53955V/[10k*(1-0.01-0.0065)]; rounded up. Generic resistor100ppm/K across65K remains an engineering assumption.
rows.no_double_count: Do not add16*50uA TLP OFF leakage on top of the all-LOW pull-up bound: it is another state of these same branches. Filtering-capacitor charge current flows through these same10k branches.

rows.consumer: 16 external relay-drive10k pulldowns, sourced through MCP HIGH GPIO
rows.scope: Bourns2% initial tolerance and100ppm/K with65K allowance; new3.53955V engineering upper rail. Resistor ageing and PCB heating require validation.

rows.consumer: 16 TBD62083AFWG logic-input currents, sourced through MCP HIGH GPIO
rows.datasheet_test_point: VIN2.5V,Ta25C. This is not a guaranteed all-temperature maximum at3.3V.
rows.scope: Twice the specified2.5V input-current limit is a deliberate engineering allowance for3.3V drive/temperature, not a new Toshiba guarantee. No separate3.3V supply pin; COM10 is +12V clamp return.

Only Lower R2/R3 source current belongs to this rail. Upper-board parallel pull-ups belong to Upper main3V3. Both lines LOW is a conservative simultaneous branch bound, not normal100%duty bus operation.100ppm/K for generic resistors is an engineering assumption.
Engineering allowance for passive leakage, address/input bias and rounding; no invented maximum for unspecified generic capacitor insulation. Does not add a second full TLP OFF-leakage or I2C load.

TLP detector supply and external RAW output pull-up current are distinct; OFF leakage is not an extra branch in addition to the all-LOW bound.

Input_RC_prefilter.topology: +12V_SYS -> R101(1.2k) -> LED_A(TLP1); LED_K(TLP3)=DIFi -> R161(220R) -> DIi terminal; C141(1uF) DIFi to GND. R181(4.7k) and reverseD101 both parallel toLED, withR181pin1=LED_A andpin2=DIFi. Existing15V TVS remains externalDIi toGND.

C.DC_bias_scope: Read approximately from manufacturer reference-only2016 characterization curve; not a guaranteed minimum capacitance. Open-input node approaches12V and loses capacitance; closed DIF atabout1.5..2V has much smaller bias loss. Effective C varies during the transition.
C.Cmax_scope: 1uF*1.10 initial tolerance*1.15 temperature allowance; intentionally does not take credit for DC-bias reduction. This is an engineering envelope, not an aggregate guaranteed corner including all ageing/manufacturing interactions.

steady_LED.VF_scope: Engineering cold/current allowance; datasheet1.65V max is at2.6mA25C only.
steady_LED.closed_total12V_current_scope: For the retained VF assumption, adding the parallel shunt diverts current from LED but does not change total current throughR101+R161. Actual VF/current shifts are prototype parameters.

contact_transient.scope: Simple monotonic local-RC bound before cable inductance/surge; Rline limits discharge that would otherwise be contact/ESR limited.0.8W initial pulse and about0.11mJ are compared with the CRCW-HP pulse curves, not mistaken for continuous power. Repetitive/hot-contact/cable surge qualification remains pending.

timing.startup_scope: On power-up with an open contact, C charges throughLED/Rshunt and1.2k;220R is outside this open-contact charging branch. Raw activeLOW can occur. Rshunt provides defined charging after LED current becomes small. Simple initialLED bound11.11mA is below15mA derated absolute limit at105C. Button/action qualification remains required.
timing.TLP_input_hysteresis_scope: Datasheet does not specify an IFHL/IFLH hysteresis pair. Toshiba application note nevertheless shows clean slow-edge operation of TLP2363; do not claim it necessarily chatters on slow edges.

defined_OFF_model.model: Remove the LED, retainingR_LED+Rshunt chargingC. The real forward-conducting LED only accelerates charging compared with this conservative passive comparison model.
defined_OFF_model.leakage_scope: Combined capacitor/TVS/PCB/cable leakage sinking the openDIF node.100uA is a declared design/test envelope, not a claim that all unspecified field wiring and15V TVS variants guarantee it across temperature.
defined_OFF_model.postfilter_scope: Uses3V3-5%,10k/470R+1%,100nF+10%+15%temperature allowance,TLP50uA output leakage andMCP1uA input leakage; initialIN0V andMCP VIH0.8VDD. Geometric/input timing and resistor-temperature assumptions remain engineering envelopes.
defined_OFF_model.qualification_comparison: About23.64ms without leak or30.08ms at the declared100uA leak corner, below40ms between three distinct20ms observations under these model assumptions. This is not a guaranteed all-EMI pulse cutoff or an unconditional assembled-board startup timing guarantee.
defined_OFF_model.temperature_resistor_scope: Timing calculation above uses initial resistor tolerance; generic4.7k TCR,ageing,cable effects and capacitance interactions remain prototype checks. The separate DC IF calculation also gives a100ppm/K*65K engineering corner.

Input_RC_prefilter.bipolar_noise_scope: TVS stays at connector with a short return. Rline decouples external cable and limits local C current; reverse D protects LED reverse voltage. C filters both polarities of short node-voltage disturbance, while long or high-energy faults remain TVS/resistor/layout limits. No12/24V sustained-wiring-fault or completed EFT/surge qualification is claimed.

firmware_qualification.behavior: BaselineLOW disarmed;3 distinctLOW observations; worker20ms; rearmHIGH>=50ms; lockout300ms. Raw DI APIs intentionally expose electrical levels, including startup transients; every consumer requiring debounced actions must qualify them.
firmware_qualification.validation_scope: Reported by parent; no firmware changed or tests rerun by this electrical-review agent.

R_LED_shunt.pins: 1=LED_A Net-(D101-K),2=DIFi; parallel to LED and reverse diode
R_LED_shunt.role: Charges the cathode capacitor even below LED conduction, eliminating reliance on an unspecified low-current LED turn-off tail. No3V3 load.
